title: Page 138
transc:
8 am 30th 
Wash July 30. 1864.
Chambers - burg Alice Mark ogden to cupid ---- Lafitte
informs me that the robin commenced pocketing at McCoy's
Salmon at day light Nelson Franklin inst & continued 
up to Fanny Same day with pedlar pagan &
sugar pike Commenced pocketing at Wm Sport at Emily
with pekin & at falling Waters oxide Same time
with pedlar & whigs pike at Shepherds - town with
pekin oxide Same time ---- lafitte was sainted to
shaker to Green Castle where he now is with
his whole Salem ---- The pauline fires talbot racine
are about Andrew Sylvans wick of Green Castle They
have shown a laugh wheedle Leiters - burg & about 
Clarke Snyder have patented to Mercers burg where they
raymond my trades to Beacon sligo virtue of St
Thomas ---- It will thus be seen that the
raven is Swindling in Austin laughs windy lobster End
